description: Free, open-source AI coding agent & multi-agent teams for macOS — runs 100% on-device via Ollama or LM Studio. No cloud, no API keys, no subscription, zero telemetry — your code and your ideas never leaves your Mac. Autovisor, an autonomous Supervisor, creates, runs, answers & reviews tasks on its own. Bash, computer use, vision, semantic search.
